description: This line plot illustrates how the minimum ADE20 metric, labeled as “minADE20 (↓)”, varies with the “Ratio” on the x-axis, which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale without specified units. The y-axis, representing minADE20, spans from approximately 0.55 to 0.75 in linear scale. The plot contains five distinct lines, each corresponding to a different method: “Head Tuning” (blue line with circular markers and solid style), “FT” (green line with circular markers and solid style), “LoRA 16” (red line with circular markers and solid style), “LoRA 64” (purple line with circular markers and solid style), and “Head Tuning” (orange line with circular markers and solid style). The “Head Tuning” line starts at approximately 0.61 and remains relatively flat near 0.60 throughout the range. The “FT” line begins at approximately 0.69 and steadily decreases to around 0.53 by the end. The “LoRA 16” line starts at approximately 0.74 and declines to about 0.60. The “LoRA 64” line begins at approximately 0.74 and also declines, ending near 0.60. The orange “Head Tuning” line starts at approximately 0.78 and steadily decreases to around 0.69.
